Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Attached is our intake form with the initial questions for the ISO27001 scoping and the FedRAMP sample windows we anticipate needing. High level asks:
- Confirm control owners for encryption, key management, logging, and config management.
- Confirm historical log retention windows (we'll request log snapshots for 90/180/365 day samples).

Quick responses / proposed plan:
- Control owners: Kimberly Park will own KMS/encryption artifacts, Ben Carter will own network & config management artifacts, I will own the overall evidence intake and sourcing cadence. We will put owners into the intake sheet and share.
- Sampling windows: we can support 90 and 365 day snapshots for logs. For dense token logs we'll provide pre-aggregated extracts and a sampling manifest to protect PII.
- Environments: prod (bound to customer data), staging (safe for dryrun), restricted (for FedRAMP shadow if needed).

Attached is our working evidence index (redwood-evidence-index-20270802.csv). I propose a short sync tomorrow (2027-08-02) at 10:00 PT to finalize owners and confirm extraction commands. If that works, we'll also share a Drive folder and a HubSpot engagement for intake tracking.
